envelope.description: Qualify performance, packaging and deployment handoff

body.title: Qualify performance, packaging and deployment handoff
body.summary: Measure the full retained managed cold, warm and history-growth workloads on the source-light production path, build the shipped package, and document coordinated restart plus explicitly authorized post-deployment smoke.
acceptanceChecks: Three cold-run median<=120s, warm<=10s, controlled admit/cancel<=2s and progress observation<=2s; report exact selected-locator counts, unique Git reads, workspace bytes, transient charged memory, heap/external/RSS and durable writes; failed gates block qualification.
Full retained workload proves no aggregate source bodies, skipped review scope or skipped mandatory coverage assessment, and confirms design review remains latest-document based.
npm build and source-free package smoke pass. Deployment waits for BUILD approval, user update/restart and explicit permission to retrigger the original review.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; prior focused regressions do not replace this full qualification.

tests.name: Retained 171-file/four-attempt cold x3, warm and history 1/4/max source-light qualification with locator/Git/workspace/memory/RSS/write metrics, exact scope and mandatory coverage.
Approved deployment handoff and explicit post-restart code/design smoke; the stopped review is retriggered only with separate user authorization.
